docs.title: Fontlab Design Assets
docs.text:
Design assets by Fontlab Ltd.

This site hosts brand and product design assets for use by Fontlab partners, press, and community.

docs.title: Sections
docs.text:
• Assets — downloadable design assets
  • About — usage guidelines and contact

docs.title: About
docs.text: These assets are published by Fontlab Ltd. for partners, press, and the type community.

docs.title: Using the assets
docs.text:
• Represent FontLab products and partnerships with the wordmark, banners, and app icons here.
  • Keep the logo intact: no stretching, no recoloring beyond the black and gray tints provided.
  • Need a size or format that is missing? Ask before improvising one.

docs.title: Contact
docs.text: For usage questions or a missing asset, open an issue on the repository.

docs.title: Assets
docs.text: Every asset lives in the repository under src_docs/assets/. Browse a pack, then use the file directly or grab the raw download from GitHub. The whole set is 169 files: logos, banners, app icons, and marketing screenshots.

docs.title: Company brand — fontlab-marketingpack-company
docs.text:
The FontLab Ltd. wordmark, in every form a layout will ask for. Browse the pack.

  • Logo font — fontlabltd-logo.otf plus its .vfj source, so the wordmark stays editable in FontLab.
  • Vector — Illustrator source (.ai) and print-ready PDFs: solid black, 25/50/75% black, and white for dark backgrounds.
  • Raster — PNG wordmarks from 50px to 1024px, in black and the three gray tints, for slides and the web.

docs.title: Product banners — fontlab-banners
docs.text:
Web banners for the FontLab "series couple" campaign, sized 728×90. Browse the pack.

  • Four themes: dark, graydark, graylight, light.
  • Each theme ships as PDF (print) and PNG (screen).

docs.title: FontLab 8 — fontlab-marketingpack-fontlab-8
docs.text:
App identity and store collateral for FontLab 8. Browse the pack.

  • App icons, full and simplified (app-icon, app-icon-simple).
  • Hero and slide headers (hero-head, slide-head) and product screenshots.
  • fontlab-8-text-suggestions.txt — approved copy for store listings.

docs.title: TransType 4 — fontlab-marketingpack-transtype-4
docs.text:
App identity and store collateral for TransType 4. Browse the pack.

  • App icon, screenshots, and composed screenshot layouts (screenshot-comps).

Licensing

These assets belong to Fontlab Ltd. Use them to represent FontLab products and partnerships. Do not alter the wordmark or recolor the logo outside the tints provided here. Questions on use go to the About page.
